name: Assamite Sorcery (Whispers of the Heavens) — Basic — Map the Skies

system.description:
Whispers of the Heavens draws on the astronomy of the Almohad Empire and Taugast alike, reconciled by generations of Assamite sorcerer-diviners. All uses of this path require a clear view of the sky, suffer a penalty in overcast weather, a greater penalty in storms, and fail outright if the sorcerer cannot see the stars at all. The first technique a student learns is the simplest: divining her own location with a glance at the heavens.

System: The player makes a Static Mental Challenge; the margin of success determines how precisely the character can fix her location, and if she has access to an accurate map she can immediately apply the knowledge to pinpoint her position on it.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens
